parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing exposure is low: no trans-specific criminal offence, no facility or birth-sex rules reaching travellers, foreign documents accepted on ordinary terms, and functioning rule of law (a 2023 supreme-court ruling protected a trans student). Self-ID, marriage equality and a new national LGBT hate-crime action plan are strong climate signals. Deductions: reported LGBT-wide hate crime has risen fivefold since 2020 (raw helpline counts, no denominator — direction, not level), the criminal hate-crime provision omits gender identity, and detention placement is unsourced outside one protective canton. These leave uncertainty and some everyday hostility risk, but no documented universal-exposure measure, organised targeting, or state hostility. A thin-data caution: silence on detention is not safety. Sits at the low end of Low Risk.
